chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Travel by night, for the earth is folded during the night."

key_terms.الْأَرْضَ: the earth or land over which one travels
key_terms.تُطْوَى: is folded, meaning the journey is made easier or shortened

ai.seo_question: Why does the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله recommend traveling at night?
ai.summary: This hadith recommends traveling at night and presents it as a beneficial and facilitated time for journeying. It reflects a Prophetic teaching on travel etiquette and practical conduct.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2394 - The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, said:
"Travel by night, for the earth is folded during the night."
